verdict.rationale: BILL's pricing page names an Invoice Coding Agent that performs automatic AI multi-line bill coding, and the S&E product page describes AI-powered spend management that auto-categorizes transactions. These show narrow, task-specific AI automation inside the product, not a general assistant users can delegate arbitrary tasks to. The documentation MCP server is a developer tool for external code editors, not an in-product assistant, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: a conversational or general-purpose in-product AI assistant, documentation of how users assign tasks to it, confirmation that the coding agent applies to Spend & Expense rather than AP only, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
